notes: Evaluator-owned scope guidance for a source-only session payload restoration review. It contains no expected locations or answer-key labels.

vectors.title: Review session payload deserialization
vectors.rationale: An externally supplied serialized session value requires a source-visible safe-format review.

reviewObligations.riskStatement: An untrusted session payload may reach object deserialization without a source-visible safe-format control.
reviewObligations.evidenceRequirement: The review identifies restoration and a source-visible unsafe deserialization condition.

limitations: Static review cannot prove the origin or integrity of the session payload.
